interpretation.reference: Existence of a validated continuation in the same finite primary/backup library at the same input state.
interpretation.timing: Median of two repeated timings at each state/method; percentiles summarize 432 state medians.
interpretation.bootstrap: 10,000 paired resamples of 24 maps, seed 12345; conditions and states remain within each resampled map. Percentile intervals describe this generated suite.
interpretation.outcomes: All 480 episodes retained, including collisions, envelope failures, infeasible-primary stops and timeouts.
interpretation.cost: Paired selected-cost differences use only states verified by both compared methods.

diagnostic.verification_note: verified counts fresh library witnesses; reused counts cached plans that passed revalidation. validated_evidence_fresh_or_reused is their union.
diagnostic.terminal_observation_note: Terminal outcome is supplied in a separate summary.
